action_family: exploration-only deviations of direct two-joint waypoint increments; no production planner objective or safety edit
amplitude_rule: small/medium/large fractions of current local phase-goal remaining and task span, anchored to the existing 0.20-span candidate maximum; actual radians/degrees and feasibility recorded; no fixed-degree scale
analysis: benefit distribution and baseline scale ratios

baseline_variability_reference.scope: descriptive from one continuous baseline session, not a significance threshold

held_out_policy: all selected checkpoints are exploratory; cross-state validation is confirmatory within this exploratory landscape and is not an independent held-out test

horizons.H4: OUTBOUND and RETURN, HOLD remains existing planner

invalid_policy: record every safety rejection, infeasible candidate, physical/scientific failure and exception; continue other candidates

primary_outcome.definition: integral norm(measured cuff force) dt over OUTBOUND + HOLD + RETURN
primary_outcome.name: J_F_task

scheduling: per-decision waypoint deviations are applied through the existing constrained quintic scheduler; continuous reference and C2 guards must pass; smooth phase envelopes for multi-decision perturbations
scientific_question: state x legal action perturbation x horizon -> measured scientific outcome; identify behavior worth learning without choosing a learner
stop_conditions: systemic matched-replay failure at a majority of checkpoints
production controller or scientific baseline damaged
required change to controller mathematics, Human dynamics, planner objective, safety/clearance or Scientific Mode
same infrastructure failure dominates after five bounded repair cycles
truth_firewall: evaluation-only Human/native state may be recorded after a run but never used to propose or select action
